I should probably make the most of this before everyone else wakes up.
The early morning sun creeps across the kitchen table, offering a rare moment of absolute steady.

Let's see... a two goes there, which makes this one a five.
A soft start to the day begins with a pencil sliding gently over the paper.

No need to rush today. I've got a few minutes to just sit here.

Check the daily rule before trusting it.

Oh, wait. That actually works out perfectly after all.

There. Now I'm officially ready to face whatever the day brings.
With the puzzle finally solved, the rest of her daily routine can begin in earnest.
